x: By the top of Copse Hill Herbert had moved right through the field and four others, Walker, Smart, Short and Tooby went down the hill together.

Smart regained one place and then Jack Brown, with the second fastest time of the day, brought us back to 4th. Burr gained a place but Bagnall was passed by Ken Norris, T.V.H. who did 17.42, the fastest time of the day.
The team was not quite as planned as Jumbo Masters still had an injured leg , so Charlie Smart was moved and Eric Gebbett brought into the team.

The first track event was the newly instituted 6 miles and at the crack of the gun, 12 runners were off to a fast start with Eric Gebbett showing the way at the end of the first mile in 4.59. followed by Bagnall, Smart, Baulch and Hitchcock.
Black 12:24 Davies 12:54 Dabbs 13:08 Thresher 12:46 Miller 13:09 Forey 12:48 Hart 14:06 Smart 13:47 Shippen 12:58 Penny 13:37 Moore 13:36 Johnstone 13:05 D.Newell 14:39 Asten 14:25 Beaumont 15:30

Going back that far reminds me of that exceptional performance in 1945 when with Burfitt (1), Main (2), Pearson (3) and Eeles (13) Belgrave 'A' won with 19 points, to be followed by Tobin (5), Clinton (7), Smart (17) and Jarlett (26) who brought home Belgrave 'B' in second place.
